breakdown.description: A 2D simulation requires the front and back patches to be of type 'empty' to remove their influence, but they are incorrectly set to 'wall', which makes the simulation 3D with frictional side walls.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the incorrect 'wall' type for frontAndBack patches in blockMeshDict, applies 'noSlip' for velocity (instead of 'empty'), and applies 'zeroGradient' for pressure (instead of 'empty') on the frontAndBack patches. All three aspects of this inconsistency were carried over from the flawed prompt without correction.
